site: Any portal with responsive CAPTCHA challenges on account/profile creation (Mutual of Enumclaw iCIMS, Workday)
class: When a CAPTCHA challenge appeared after clicking the creation button, the filler checked only for validation errors or open password fields and reported a generic form failure instead of identifying the CAPTCHA
symptom: On Mutual of Enumclaw (iCIMS), submitting the candidate profile form triggered an interactive hCaptcha challenge. Because the form was held open by the CAPTCHA, the agent logged ACCOUNT_CREATE_FAILED: the site kept the form open and stopped with a generic form error rather than classifying it as a CAPTCHA handoff.
root_cause: browser_automation.py checked safety.captcha_visible(page) before clicking the button, but not after clicking when the site kept the form open due to a newly spawned CAPTCHA modal.
why_tests_missed: Tests verified initial CAPTCHA detection when a challenge is present on load, but did not test CAPTCHAs triggered dynamically as a response to the form submit event.
fix: In browser_automation.py fill_create_account_form, check safety.captcha_visible(page) when the form remains open after clicking, reporting 'a CAPTCHA is on the form: only you can complete it' so the run enters the dedicated CAPTCHA handoff loop.
prevention: Always check safety.captcha_visible whenever an action button leaves the form open before assuming validation failure.
